prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one complete desktop Regex benchmarks subpage design for Ferroni, in a coordinated eight-page library website design suite.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is the previously accepted Ferroni "Regex benchmarks" subpage, the EDIT TARGET and information/content hierarchy reference. Preserve its useful reading structure, clear code and data, semantics and section order.
Image 2 is the approved final warm Ferroni homepage, the EXACT VISUAL FAMILY REFERENCE. Match its warm beige paper fibers, matte pewter, rust-brown oxide, warm dark ink, grotesk type, margins, restrained functional rules, small product logo and refined mechanical materials. This is the selected direction, not an opportunity to invent another palette or theme.

COMMON FAMILY RULES:
Light theme only. Refined precision engineering, warm and technically literate, never brutal or dirty. Palette roles: paper #F4F0E6, inlay #FBFAF6, pewter #DCDDD6, ink #29362F, muted #5C655B, accent #88492F.
Use a continuous very light warm-paper reading ground with restrained fine fiber texture. A broad, very light matte-pewter evidence/reference surface may organize one meaningful major figure. Texture illumination is a subtle physical material effect, not a floating color gradient or decorative glow. Paper-white inlays keep small code, tables and notes clear.
Retain the approved homepage's humanist industrial sans/grotesk typography, moderate weights, open leading and generous horizontal gutters. Monospace is for code and exact data. Keep the top navigation and footer in the same family as Image 2, including its existing small product symbol with a real wordmark. The logo should read at an ordinary 32–64px display size, not as a tiny speck.
Documentation pages use a practical narrow left navigation rail and a generous main reading/code column. The homepage's small introductory margin can inform explanatory sections when helpful, but never add a second competing left rail that squeezes the code. Similar content receives the same treatment in both products: installation specimen, code result, reference table, measurement figure, trust note, next-step links.
Use ample vertical whitespace and reading line lengths. No decorative horizontal lines between every story, heavy borders, repeated card grids, dark sections, dirty rust, woodgrain, photo walls or ornate bolt framing. Functional table rules and navigation cues remain quiet and purposeful. Numbering is appropriate only for a real ordered procedure. Do not shrink long code or notes into unreadable microtype.
The hero instrument must retain a derivable purpose: Ferromark registers a source document with HTML and a metadata leaf; Ferroni compares pattern cassettes over a text ribbon and locates the next match. Preserve the actual reference instrument identity. No invented unrelated metal objects.

PAGE-SPECIFIC DIRECTION:
An evidence-led documentation page matching the Ferromark benchmark page. Keep practical left navigation, a readable main column and an optional slim on-page outline. The intro uses title, recorded conditions and a modest comparator-instrument crop. The full pairwise Steady reuse table sits on one broad very light matte-pewter measurement surface, with clean light reading inlays, airy rows and decimal-aligned values. Preserve the Compile / First use / Steady reuse lifecycle navigation. Keep all four comparator rows, two architecture columns and Tasks counts exactly. The Onigmo row has 20 tasks; the other rows have 21. Methodology and caveats sit on warm paper below. Do not imply that different pairwise task sets form a universal ranking. Preserve the C-compile and PCRE2-JIT tradeoffs and the correctness-before-timing rule. Remove large numbered circles from ordinary prose sections.

TEXT AND EVIDENCE:
Use the exact source copy below for facts, code, API names, numbers and recorded conditions. Do not invent performance, compatibility, security, version or usage claims. Do not repeat incidental generated glyph errors from Image 1 when they conflict with this copy. This is a visual comp; source files remain authoritative.
# Regex benchmarks

Check the output before measuring the time.

Measured October 15, 2026 · revision 1c8d45f
Blacksmith VMs: macOS ARM64 and Linux x86-64
21 tasks · 513 inputs
Compile · First use · Steady reuse

## Steady reuse

Ferroni throughput relative to each engine. Higher is faster.
Each row is a pairwise comparison on tasks both engines can run.

Comparator | macOS ARM64 | Linux x86-64 | Tasks
C Oniguruma | 3.44× | 2.75× | 21
Onigmo | 3.92× | 3.61× | 20
PCRE2 interpreter | 2.07× | 1.85× | 21
PCRE2 JIT | 0.70× | 0.63× | 21

## Where the tradeoff sits

C Oniguruma compiles patterns faster. Ferroni pays off when a prepared pattern runs many times.
PCRE2 JIT is faster in these steady-reuse aggregates.

## Same output first

An engine that rejects a pattern or returns a different result is excluded from that task before timing.
These are isolated regex steps, not full applications.

## How the result is assembled

Three processes per platform, separate VMs, 30 samples per phase. Ratios are geometric means within task families, then across families.
Rows cover different task sets and are not a universal ranking.
